answer: A layered shale bond stops bulk fake identities. Each identity locks 70 credits in three shale layers: 30 topsoil, 20 middle, 20 sealed in basalt. Filing costs 15 a layer, 45 per identity. Each epoch a zephyr beacon names one layer for audit; the auditor replays that layer and burns any record copied or rented. 1,000 fakes pay 115 each, 115,000 total, against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 45 once and keep their bond.
